claims.statement: Ludovico Sforza grants Leonardo a vineyard outside the Porta Vercellina. Leonardo later bequeaths it in his will.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Ducal grant; will of 1519.

timeline.text: Ludovico Sforza grants Leonardo a vineyard outside the Porta Vercellina. Leonardo later bequeaths it in his will.

flags: The year may be wrong. Recall suggests the grant to Leonardo dates from 2 April 1499, not 1498.
